test_suite_name: V3 photon fire transaction rollback and retry

tests.name: Bootstrap SysOp
Create ordinary photon player
Create ordinary photon target
Select a clean adjacent photon sector

data.sql: SELECT w.to_sector FROM players p JOIN sector_warps w ON w.from_sector=p.sector_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM planets pl JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE pl.sector_id=w.to_sector AND COALESCE(c.planetaryShields,0)>0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects e WHERE e.sector_id=w.to_sector) ORDER BY w.to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Prepare eligible ship and exact ammunition

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET type_id=(SELECT shiptypes_id FROM shiptypes WHERE name='Missile Frigate'),photons=3,destroyed=FALSE,onplanet=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_atomic_qa');

tests.name: Move target owner to adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target} WHERE name='photon_atomic_target';

tests.name: Place photon target in adjacent sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target},shields=0,combat_disabled_until=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_atomic_target');

tests.name: Save photon target ship ID

data.sql: SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_atomic_target';

tests.name: Reject a non-adjacent target without partial mutation
Non-adjacent refusal conserves ammo, effects and receipts

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.photons=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE player_id=p.player_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=9999) AND (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id})=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Reject a nonexistent target without partial mutation
Invalid-target refusal conserves ammo, sector and ship state

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.photons=3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE player_id=p.player_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target}) AND (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id})=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Set photon ammunition to zero for refusal check

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET photons=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_atomic_qa');

tests.name: Reject insufficient ammunition
Insufficient ammunition creates no receipt, effect or target state

data.sql: SELECT s.photons=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE player_id=p.player_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target}) AND (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id})=0 FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Restore ammunition for transaction rollback test

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET photons=3 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='photon_atomic_qa');

tests.name: Install a controlled failure after ammo/effect updates

data.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_qa_fail_photon_request() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled photon rollback'; END $$;

tests.name: Attach failure to durable request insert

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_qa_fail_photon_request BEFORE INSERT ON photon_fire_requests FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_qa_fail_photon_request();

tests.name: Injected request insert failure returns an error
Ammo, sector effect, request and event all roll back

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.photons=3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sector_photon_effects WHERE sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM photon_fire_requests WHERE player_id=p.player_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.photon_fired.v1' AND actor_player_id=p.player_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Remove controlled photon failure trigger
Remove controlled photon failure function
Retry firing after rollback succeeds once
Retry the committed request returns the same receipt without another debit
Retry leaves one durable debit/effect/request/event

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.photons=2 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photon_fire_requests r WHERE r.player_id=p.player_id AND r.sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target})=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sector_photon_effects e WHERE e.sector_id=@{photon_rollback_target})=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events e WHERE e.type='combat.photon_fired.v1' AND e.actor_player_id=p.player_id)=1 AND (SELECT combat_disabled_until FROM ships WHERE ship_id=@{photon_target_ship_id})>EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.name='photon_atomic_qa';
